'''Ander Tol''' is a skinny, toothless Cairhienin farmer. He comes from south of the city of Cairhien.

==History==
[[Cadsuane]] asked Ander Tol to give her, and to an injured [[Rand]], [[Min]], [[Samitsu]], [[Niande]], Lady [[Caraline Damodred]], and Lord [[Darlin Sisnera]] a ride back to the [[Sun Palace]] after they escape from the [[Bubble of evil]] fog that encompassed the rebel camp of [[Toram Riatin]].
